zh.park_subtitle: 桂林山水甲天下 · 国际旅游胜地
zh.location: 中国广西壮族自治区桂林市
zh.rivers: 漓江 · 遇龙河 · 桃花江
zh.heritage_desc: 2014年列入联合国教科文组织《世界遗产名录》
zh.currency_desc: 兴坪漓江段入选第五套人民币20元纸币背面图案
zh.geology_desc: 石灰岩溶蚀地貌，峰林平原相映成趣
zh.elephant_desc: 桂林城市象征，象鼻饮水的千古奇观
zh.liriver_desc: 83公里水墨长卷，中国最美河流之旅
zh.reedflute_desc: 大自然艺术之宫，千年溶洞奇观
zh.yangshuo_desc: 中西文化交融的背包客天堂
zh.longji_desc: 650年农耕文明杰作，大地上的雕塑艺术
zh.sevenstar_desc: 桂林最大的综合性公园，国宝大熊猫之家
zh.tworivers_desc: 环城水系夜景，灯火璀璨的水城风光
zh.ticket_desc: 漓江游船¥300+，多数景点门票¥55-110
zh.transport_plane_desc: 桂林两江国际机场，距市区25公里（30分钟车程），打车约¥60-80，机场大巴约¥20
zh.transport_train_desc: 桂林站（高铁站）、桂林北站、桂林西站，市区内均有地铁接驳
zh.transport_bus_desc: 桂林汽车南站有发往各县及阳朔的班车，到阳朔约1.5小时，票价¥30
zh.transport_car_desc: 导航至桂林市中心或具体景点，大部分景点停车方便，市区停车费约¥10-20/天

en.park_subtitle: Guilin's Scenery is the Best Under Heaven · International Destination
en.location: Guilin City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China
en.rivers: Li River · Yulong River · Taohua River
en.heritage_desc: Listed as UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site in 2014 (South China Karst)
en.currency_desc: The Xingping Li River section features on China's 20 yuan banknote since 1999
en.geology_desc: Limestone dissolution landform — peaks and plains in perfect harmony
en.elephant_desc: City symbol of Guilin — an elephant drinking from the Li River
en.liriver_desc: 83km ink-wash painting journey — China's most beautiful river trip
en.reedflute_desc: Palace of Natural Arts — a millennium-old cave wonder
en.longji_desc: 650-year-old agricultural masterpiece — sculpture carved into the mountain
en.sevenstar_desc: Guilin's largest scenic park — home to giant pandas
en.tworivers_desc: Enchanting night cruise through the illuminated water city
en.best_time_desc: April–October ideal; September–November for clear skies and comfortable temps
en.duration_desc: Minimum 3 days, 5–7 days for an immersive experience
en.ticket_desc: Li River cruise ¥300+, most attraction tickets ¥55–110
en.transport_plane_desc: Guilin Liangjiang Intl Airport (KWL), 25km to city (~30 min). Taxi: ¥60–80 | Airport bus: ¥20. Show driver: 桂林市中心
en.transport_train_desc: Guilin Station (HSR), North Station, West Station — all connected to metro/bus lines
en.transport_bus_desc: Bus from South Bus Station to Yangshuo: ~1.5 hrs, ¥30. Show driver: 阳朔
en.transport_car_desc: Navigate to Guilin city center or specific attractions. Parking widely available, ~¥10–20/day
